description: List the contacts that are members of one group. Identify the group by group_id (preferred) or group_name — not both. LACRM: GetContactsInGroup.

group_id.description: The group id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

group_name.description: The group name, if you do not have its id.

name: lacrm_list_contacts_in_group
title: List contacts in a group
